propositions: A new [code_health] configuration section must be defined as a dataclass in _config_schema.py with typed fields: enabled (bool, default False), scan_roots (list[str]), analyzers (dict[str,str]), size_cap (int or None), and size_near_fraction (float).
The [code_health] section must support command-line override via rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val> using the existing override parsing mechanism.
The [code_health] section must be re-exported through config.py and must appear in tests/golden/config_surface.json with the golden test validating the surface.

Runtime behavior consumption of the config and the fallback when unconfigured remain out of scope; this ticket defines schema only and does not modify git_metrics.py hardcodes or migration 0734 runtime logic.
